description: This file defines the implementation of the ControlIpcTestBase class, which provides setup, teardown, and utility methods for testing ControlIpc components in a media control IPC system. It includes mock object management, event subscription handling, and client registration logic.

classes.name: ControlIpcTestBase
classes.description: A base class for testing ControlIpc components, providing setup, teardown, and mock management functions.

methods.name: ControlIpcTestBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing mock objects and internal state.

methods.name: createControlIpc
methods.description: Sets up the ControlIpc instance and subscribes to events.

methods.name: destroyControlIpc
methods.description: Cleans up the ControlIpc instance and unsubscribes from events.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Mocks the registration of a client and verifies success.

methods.name: expectSubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets expectations for subscribing to specific events.

methods.name: expectUnsubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets expectations for unsubscribing from specific events.
